mandate: C313 — costed OOS sweep of the COIN-M inverse quarterly term-structure / calendar-basis carry family (960 pre-registered configs) on real COIN-M inverse 1h klines (data.futures.cm). Long cheap / short rich via annualized basis cross-sectional rank; exact inverse settlement PnL notional*(1/entry-1/exit)*weight; 3 legs x3 costs; Holm+BH at alpha=0.05; expanding train 12m/test 3m/roll 3m; MDE + stability gates; carry vs convexity attribution.

config.cost_rule: 3 legs x (fee+slippage) bps per leg; 3 legs per trade -> costs x3

methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs equal-weight B&H-with-costs; Holm step-down and Benjamini-Hochberg step-up over 960 pre-registered configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.stability: stable iff exposure>0, net_sum>0, net_mean>0 within sub-period; sign consistency >=70% splits and first-half vs second-half Sharpe corr >=0.5.
methodology.attribution: inverse-settlement PnL decomposed into linear carry and convexity; carry_share = linear/total.
methodology.inverse_settlement: exact inverse return (entry-exit)/exit; linear carry is approximation only for attribution.
methodology.cost_realism: per-leg cost = (fee+slippage) bps; taker uses fee, maker used fee/2; 3 legs per trade -> costs x3; funding excluded (control leg).

slimmed.reason: per-split series dropped; keeps sweep < 100 MB push limit
